meta.title: The Seat in the Front
meta.logline: Growing up in the back seat watching older siblings drive, the youngest family member nervously learns the steering wheel and eventually becomes the reliable driver everyone calls at night.
meta.audience: Family, friends, and short-film reviewers watching on vertical mobile screens.
meta.intent: Evoke quiet nostalgia, personal growth, and warm familial pride.

shots.reason: Establishes the narrator's early life perspective always watching from the back seat.

keyframe.prompt: Young Ethiopian boy sitting quietly in the rear car seat looking forward between front headrests, warm interior glow, soft evening sunlight.

motion.prompt: Slow push forward toward the young boy watching intently.

narration.text_am: ሁልጊዜ ከጀርባ ወንበር ላይ ተቀመጥኩ ነበር።
narration.text_en: I always sat in the back seat growing up.

shots.reason: Captures the cozy warmth of childhood car rides with family in motion.

keyframe.prompt: Over-the-shoulder view from back seat towards older brother driving, golden hour blurred city lights through windshield, cozy ambiance.

motion.prompt: slow push in, soft light drifts

narration.text_en: Listening to my family laugh and talk.

shots.reason: Focuses on the art of driving as seen through an observant younger child's eyes.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of experienced hands comfortably steering a car wheel, amber dashboard backlight illuminating smooth leather.

motion.prompt: slow push in, soft light drifts

narration.text_am: ታላላቆቼ መኪና ሲነዱ ለማየት እጓጓ ነበር።
narration.text_en: Watching my older siblings take the wheel.

shots.reason: Marks the narrative turning point where narrator steps into the driver's seat.

keyframe.prompt: Young Ethiopian adult sitting nervous in the driver's seat on a quiet empty suburban road, cool dusk lighting.

motion.prompt: Slow camera pull back revealing the driver alone behind the wheel.

narration.text_en: Then came the day I sat in the driver's seat.

motion.prompt: slow push in, soft light drifts

narration.text_en: My hands gripped the wheel so tight.

shots.reason: Shows growing self-awareness and careful responsibility behind the wheel.

motion.prompt: slow push in, soft light drifts

narration.text_en: Checking the mirror over and over.

keyframe.prompt: Smartphone resting on passenger seat lighting up brightly in dark car interior, blurred night city lights outside window.

motion.prompt: Gentle camera tilt down toward glowing phone screen.

narration.text_en: Now, late at night, my phone lights up.

shots.reason: Illustrates late-night reliability and navigating dark roads with confidence.

motion.prompt: slow push in, soft light drifts

narration.text_en: Everyone calls me when they need a lift.

shots.reason: Depicts the emotional payoff of helping loved ones and earning their trust.

motion.prompt: Slow pan right from driver to smiling mother closing car door.

narration.text_en: The quiet kid from the back seat...
